title: Sharp edge-spectral supersaturation for odd cycles
summary: Let \(G\) be a graph with \(m\) edges and adjacency spectral radius\(ρ(G)\), and let \(N(C_{2k+1},G)\) denote the number of copies of \(C_{2k+1}\) in \(G\). For each fixed integer \(k\ge 2\), define \( g_k(m):=\frac{k-1+\sqrt{4m-k^2+1}}{2}. \) Li, Zhai and Shu [European J. Combin., 2024] determined the spectral extremal threshold for odd cycles by proving that, for all sufficiently large \(m\), every \(C_{2k+1}\)-free graph \(G\) with \(m\) edges satisfies \(ρ(G)\le g_k(m)\).
